It covers adding support for GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM) with remark-gfm and implementing syntax highlighting for code blocks with react-syntax-highlighter. items.title: Batch Merging TS Files Using ffmpy3
items.summary: This article provides a concise tutorial on how to batch merge multiple TS video files into a single MP4 file using Python. It demonstrates the use of the ffmpy3 library, a Python wrapper for FFmpeg, explaining how to create a file list and use a simple script to execute the -f concat and -c copy commands for a fast, lossless merge.
